notes.title: Lazer Cops going free!
notes.content:
Howdy space cop! It's been nearly 2 years since release, and understandably the influx of new players has slowed considerably as more and more games are released on Steam. Ideally we would change the pricing to be pay what you want (which we believe is the future of digital purchases), alas Steam does not support this feature.

Moving forward, we have decided to make the game free on February 1st, allowing more people can enjoy the game. We thank those who purchased the game earlier, allowing us to continue to create increasingly different and unique games. See you, Space Cowboy.

notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
As always, there's a few bugs that needs squishing, so we've got an update for y'all!
[list]
[*]Changed layers of Player 3 & 4 so they don't appear below tether
[*]Centered Victory/Defeat text
[*]Changed Disco Dan to remove the stage 2 disco lazers immediately when stage 3 starts
[*]Disabled all healing in Versus mode
[*]Tweaked Spy Net's dialogue
[*]Improved hit detection on upwards moving obstacles in Spy Net
[*]Made Spy Net slightly easier
[*]Made levels in the first zone slightly easier
[/list]
Happy policing!

notes.title: Update 1!
notes.content:
Howdy. Based on initial feedback, we've pushed an update with the following changes:
[list]
    [*]Made levels in the first zone easier on 'Easy' mode
    [*]Changed the drawing layer of the player vehicles and tether to no longer be obscured by explosions and flames
    [*]Made the set controller screen easier to understand
    [*]Fixed bug in the options menu on the main menu
[/list]
Enjoy!

notes.title: Let's Ride! Lazer Cops has been released
notes.content:
Get your groove on, buddy. It's time to ride! Lazer Cops is now available for purchase on Steam and Itch.io.

Development's taken a while, but we hope you enjoy this neon-infused adventure. Let us know what you think! All feedback is appreciated.
